title: A Self-Dual Frame Formalism of the SO(3) Yang-Mills Theory
summary: For a closed oriented Riemannian $4$-manifold $(M,g)$, we consider $\operatorname{SO}(3)$ connections on the bundle $Λ^+$ of self-dual $2$-forms. On the open locus where the self-dual curvature is an orientation-preserving frame, pointwise polar decomposition removes the gauge freedom and replaces the connection by a positive self-adjoint endomorphism field $h$ of $Λ^+$. Using the classical reconstruction of the compatible connection $A(h)$, we obtain a global formulation of the Yang--Mills equation as the determined second order system $$ Φ_g(h):=F_{A(h)}^+h^{-1}-\operatorname{Id}=0. $$…
